author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

`DetIdToRecHitMapProducer` skips a configured rechit collection that is missing from the event. Before this PR it wrote an unnamed warning on every event. Now the warning names the missing InputTag, and it is written once per job for each collection. The map that the producer writes does not change.

This makes the problem fixed in #52319 visible: on a standard RECO file the plain barrel and forward PFRecHits are absent, and the warning now says which collection is missing.

#### PR validation:

The producer ran on a 34834.88 RECO file that does not hold `particleFlowRecHitECAL` and `particleFlowRecHitHBHE`. In 20 events it wrote two warnings, one for each collection, and each names its tag. The resolved hit index is identical to the one made without this PR. The build is clean on `el8_amd64_gcc14`, and code-format is applied.
title: DetIdToRecHitMapProducer: name a missing rechit collection, once per job
